defs.def: to want sth to happen or to be true even though it is unlikely or impossible 通常不用于现在进行时
to want to do sth; to want sth to happen 希望（做某事）；想要（某事发生）

ex.s: What I wish I taught my daughter earlier are these nuances.
ex.t: 我希望更早教给我女儿的是这些细微差别。

ex.s: The Language Exchange Programme allows students in pairs to communicate in two different languages they wish to share and learn each week.
ex.t: 语言交换项目让学生两人一组，每周用两种他们希望分享和学习的不同语言进行交流。

ex.s: Two fifth wish to increase the value of their house.
ex.t: 五分之二的人希望提升自己房子的价值。

ex.s: “I wish we could help him to earn money.” said Clara.
ex.t: 克拉拉说:“我希望我们能帮助他赚钱。”

ex.s: “I wish we could help him to earn money,” said Clara.
ex.t: 克拉拉说,“我希望我们能帮助他赚钱。”

ex.s: She wishes to go back to her home country.
ex.t: 她希望回到自己的祖国。

ex.s: Fascinated by his words, Dorian wishes he could remain young and good-looking always, with his portrait growing old instead of him.
ex.t: 被他的话深深吸引，多里安希望自己能永远保持年轻英俊，而让他的画像代替他变老。

ex.s: He is right, but I can’t help wishing they would keep those old ferries.
ex.t: 他说得对，但我还是忍不住希望他们能保留那些旧渡轮。

defs.def: to think very hard that you want sth, especially sth that can only be achieved by good luck or magic 盼望；企求；想要
to say that you hope that sb will be happy, lucky, etc. 祝；祝愿

ex.s: If, at a later date, you wish to apply for a job or graduate school where an official copy of your UCLA record is required, it will be to your advantage to provide an impressive academic record.
ex.t: 如果在以后的日子里，你申请的工作或研究生院需要你的加州大学洛杉矶分校成绩单的正式副本，那么提供一份令人印象深刻的学业记录将对你有好处。

ex.s: To all, I wish a pleasant trip, to groups off for a family wedding in Singapore, to seniors travelling to Rome for holiday, to children off to Disney World in Orlando...the airport is not a dull place.
ex.t: 祝所有人旅途愉快，无论是前往新加坡参加家族婚礼的团体、去罗马度假的老人，还是出发去奥兰多迪士尼乐园的孩子……机场不是个沉闷的地方。

ex.s: With best wishes, Class 8 1 What is the purpose of the letter?
ex.t: 致以最美好的祝愿，八班 1 这封信的目的是什么？

defs.def: a desire or a feeling that you want to do sth or have sth 愿望；希望

ex.s: Awake from a short sleep in her chair, my grandmother ran her fingers through her wavy white hair, looked out her window at the blue sky, and asked me what I would wish for if I had just one wish.
ex.t: 祖母从椅子上的短暂小睡中醒来，手指捋过波浪般的白发，望向窗外蓝天，问我如果只有一个愿望，我会许什么愿。

ex.s: Each year my children would write up their Christmas wish lists.
ex.t: 每年孩子们都会写下他们的圣诞愿望清单。

ex.s: “I wish you could see him,” she said to her own children, John, Harry, and Clara.
ex.t: 她对自己的孩子约翰、哈里和克拉拉说:“我希望你能见到他。”

ex.s: “I wish you could see him,” she said to her own children, John, Harry, and Clara.
ex.t: 她对自己的孩子约翰、哈里和克拉拉说:“我希望你能见到他。”

ex.s: My mother was not afraid of Mrs Calloway She wished me to have my own library card to check out books for myself.
ex.t: 我妈妈不害怕Calloway太太她希望我有自己的借书证可以自己借书。

ex.s: A machine with a specific purpose has another quality, one that we usually associate with living things: a wish to preserve its own existence.
ex.t: 一台有特定用途的机器还有另一种品质，一种我们通常与生物联系在一起的品质：保全自身存在的愿望。

ex.s: Soon afterwards, Dorian is surprised to find his wish has come true, after he meets Sybil, an innocent actress who falls in love with him.
ex.t: 不久之后，多里安惊讶地发现他的愿望实现了，他遇到了一个无辜的女演员西比尔，后者爱上了他。

ex.s: 20     It’s rare to hear someone say, “I wish that speaker had spoken longer.” On the other hand, you probably can’t count the times that you’ve thought, “I’m glad that talk is over.
ex.t: 20     很少听到有人说："我希望那位演讲者能讲得更久。"另一方面，你可能数不清有多少次你想："真高兴那个演讲终于结束了。"它似乎永远没完没了！所以给你的听众一个惊喜吧。

ex.s: For those wishing to park near friends, all vehicles must have passes for the same zone and arrive together — spaces cannot be saved.
ex.t: 对于想把车停在朋友附近的人，所有车辆必须持有同一区域的停车证并同时到达——车位不能预留。

ex.s: It’s better to leave your listeners wishing for more than shifting restlessly in their seats waiting for your speech finally to end.
ex.t: 与其让你的听众焦躁不安地在座位上挪动、等着你的演讲终于结束，不如让他们意犹未尽。

ex.s: In fact, anyone wishing to try race walking should probably first consult a coach or experienced racer to learn proper technique, she says.
ex.t: 她说，事实上，任何想尝试竞走的人可能都应先咨询教练或有经验的竞走者，以学习正确技术。

defs.def: a thing that you want to have or to happen 想要的东西；希望的事

ex.s: It didn’t tum out as I had wished.
ex.t: 结果并不像我希望的那样。

ex.s: I texted him and expressed wishes for him to come out again.
ex.t: 这些可爱的小猎手只是在做它们从远古时代起就刻在本能里的事情。

ex.s: Every artiste wish is to create something that expresses an idea.
ex.t: 每位艺人的愿望都是创造出能表达某种想法的东西。

defs.def: an attempt to make sth happen by thinking hard about it, especially in stories when it often happens by magic 愿；心愿

ex.s: I’m glad you will be contributing to the household." My dad’s words made me realize that my earnings might not be mine to do with as I wished.
ex.t: 我很高兴你能为这个家庭贡献力量。” 我父亲的话让我意识到，我的收入可能不是按我的意愿来支付的。

defs.def: （书信或贺卡等中的）祝愿，祝福
